answer: A commit-reveal identity registry with a cooldown stops sybil farms at the door: an agent first commits a hidden sparrow-light pledge, then reveals it only after a waiting period in the open harbor of public scrutiny. A gale of fake registrations cannot rush through, because each identity must sit through its cooldown while peers check the pledge against earlier ones. One farm spawning thousands of identities faces thousands of waiting periods it cannot parallelize away.
